Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim documentation. Can you confirm
you are comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where the collision happened.
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in League City, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the
main entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had checked my mirrors and was backing slowly. The other vehicle was coming down the aisle, and I didn't see it
until it was already close.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving?
A: Maybe walking pace, a few miles an hour. I was barely moving.
Q: Did the other driver stop, or did they try to avoid contact?
A: They braked, but there wasn't enough room. Our bumpers met on the rear corner of my car.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle right away?
A: Yes, I got out to look at the damage. I felt fine at first, but later that evening my right shoulder started hurting badly.
Q: Where is the pain now, and have you sought medical care?
A: It's in the front and top of my right shoulder. I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning, and they took X-rays
and told me to rest it and follow up with my own doctor.
Q: Have you been able to work or carry out daily activities since then?
A: Some things are hard. Lifting anything with my right arm hurts, and I've had to limit my driving for a while.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send the clniic paperwork when I have it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
